name: Cairo Pentagons
desc: The Cairo pentagonal pavement caught mid-morph — a single parameter breathes the whole one-parameter family, sliding the tiling from diagonal squares through the true 120/90 Cairo pentagon to basketweave rectangles while the plane drifts and turns beneath it.

energy.doc: how far the tiling swings across its family each cycle (at max it runs the whole range, squares to basketweave)

density.doc: ornament worked into every tile — inset course, then a centre stud

morph.doc: resting point in the family: 0 = squares on the diagonal, 0.405 = the true Cairo pentagon (120/90/120/90/120), 0.54 = equilateral Cairo, 1 = basketweave

x.doc: lattice origin x as canvas fraction

y.doc: lattice origin y as canvas fraction

style.doc: aesthetic: cast concrete pavement in four castings / jewel-toned cloisonné enamel between dark cell walls / brushed ink outlines on paper, no fills / two-ink risograph plates / pure abstraction — the tiling quantises a drifting continuous field, no outlines at all

seed.doc: deterministic seed for per-tile tone variation and the field
